reason: A DeepSeek Harness companion plugin centered on persona injection and persistent cross-session memory, with an optional QQ messaging channel.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 SOUL、USER 和 MEMORY 文件的人设陪伴与跨会话记忆，并可选接入 QQ 消息通道。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness companion plugin that provides persona configuration, persistent cross-session memory, and an optional QQ messaging channel.

capabilities: Renders persona and persistent memory files into agent context
Provides an update_memory tool that modifies USER.md and MEMORY.md
Optionally connects to QQ through configured app credentials to relay agent messages
Exposes status checks for memory usage and QQ connectivity
